rejected.reason: 德斯帕手持一只哑铃，直接违反该项的 dumbbell-free row rehearsal 要求；其余人物、食物和透明度均可读，但不能以此接受。
rejected.recommendedAdjustedRetryPrompt: Wide 16:9 wordless course cover. Exactly one Despa rehearses an unweighted row movement: he leans lightly forward with one empty hand resting on a plain bench and his other empty elbow drawn back; use absolutely no dumbbell, barbell, kettlebell, resistance band, weight plate, handle, or other exercise equipment. Exactly one short Bojji arranges one plain plate with egg, tofu, beans and rice. Convey protein and training recovery only through the calm empty-hand row rehearsal and the food. No labels, powder tubs, text, brand package, arrows, rays, markers, thought bubble, floor, shadow or halo.
